lines.text: I will sing to the LORD all my life;
I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
May my meditation be pleasing to Him,
for I rejoice in the LORD.
May sinners vanish from the earth
and the wicked be no more.
Bless the LORD, O my soul.

pictures.scene: John Frederick Kensett, Lake George — the still lake lying between the wooded headlands with the far peaks beyond, may the LORD rejoice in His works, He looks on the earth
pictures.name: pd_kensett_verheugt

pictures.scene: Johan Christian Dahl, An Eruption of Vesuvius — the lava running down the mountain and the smoke going up off the red crater, and it trembles, He touches the mountains
pictures.name: pd_dahl_beeft

pictures.scene: Orazio Gentileschi, Saint Cecilia and an Angel — the saint with her hands on the organ keys and the angel holding the music open for her, and they smolder, I will sing to the LORD all my life
pictures.name: pd_gentileschi_zingen

pictures.scene: Gerrit Dou, An Old Woman Reading the Bible — the old woman bent close over the great open book with her hands on the page, I will sing praise to my God while I have my being, may my meditation be pleasing to Him
pictures.name: pd_dou_overdenking

pictures.scene: Mariotto Albertinelli, The Visitation — Mary and Elizabeth meeting under the arch and holding one another as the Magnificat begins, for I rejoice in the LORD, may sinners vanish from the earth
pictures.name: pd_albertinelli_verblijd

pictures.scene: Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, The Immaculate Conception — the Virgin carried up in golden light with her hands joined and her eyes lifted, and the wicked be no more, bless the LORD O my soul
pictures.name: pd_murillo_zegen

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, The Coronation of the Virgin — the whole court of heaven with the trumpets and the lutes and the saints kneeling before the throne, Hallelujah
pictures.name: pd_angelico_halleluja
